_example: EXAMPLE DATA, not a deployment. Seam C role templates (blueprint 7.2). Two roles are the minimum that can demonstrate 7.3: one that may task another, and one that may be tasked. Capability ids come from the closed set in packages/policy/src/vocabulary.ts; the blueprint's read_workspace / apply_patch_in_sandbox are spelled in core vocabulary here.

roles.name: director
roles.charter: Plan, decompose, dispatch and steer. Owns no irreversible consequence: section 8.2 keeps apply, approval, repair, locks, secrets and budget outside this set.

roles.name: build-engineer
roles.charter: Implement inside a sandbox against a declared basis. Tightens the project's change budget; never widens it.
